statement: Twenty cases have author-checked archives. Round two gained 118 summed SOL units on 12/12 new cases; a bounded author handoff added 2 more. Random repair won development; no general new-method advantage.
status: Open for pre-release contributor trials and expert-agent review; scientific acceptance pending.
scope: Four-neighbor static point agents; 32x32, 48x48 and 64x64 grids; explicit budgets and separate SOC/SOL/makespan.
reproduce_full: python tools/prepare.py; python tools/run_trial.py (in a copy; native deadline runs may differ)

assumptions.statement: MAPF-LNS2 and other strong alternatives still need matched-objective comparison; no exhaustive state-of-art claim.
Broader local archive gains are established, but a new generally superior policy is not.
